_comment: 벌칙 룰렛 목록. 술 없이도 되는 것 위주(잔은 음료 OK). 성적·신체 접촉 강요·타인에게 피해 가는 벌칙 금지. 순서는 페이지 노출 순서.

penalties.en: Finish your drink (anything counts)
Three sincere compliments for the person next to you
Three seconds of aegyo
Read your last three searches out loud
Show your lock screen
Show the last photo in your gallery
Speak formally until the next round
Answer the next card twice

penalties.ko: 전 애인 이름 첫 글자 공개
penalties.en: First letter of your ex's name

penalties.en: Impersonate someone here
One line of a song, with feeling
Take a selfie right now and post it in the group chat
Show who you called last

Don't blink for ten seconds

Send a single "lol" to your most recent chat
